Similar to the check in `showScrim`, it's more robust to use an inequality here, such as `self.scrimView.alpha <= 0.0f`, to prevent potential floating-point precision issues.
Comparing floating-point numbers for exact equality can be fragile. It's safer to use an inequality, like `self.scrimView.alpha >= 1.0f`, to avoid issues with floating-point precision.
